Lemma
[Uniform noncollapsing of the normalized approximants] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0119, page-0120 1. ch19:19.40\group Spherical Construction

The rescaled and time-translated approximants $\hat g_L(t)$ in Perelman's construction are $\kappa $-noncollapsed, with $\kappa $ independent of $L$, on all scales $r\le \sqrt{T_L/(4(T_L-t_L))}$.
